name: Spill
description: Tall capsules chopped into segments by clean cut gaps, so a three-cell run reads as a run of beads.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 62%; margin-left: 19%; height: @pick(100%, 200%, 300%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 999px; -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 26%, transparent 26% 32%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 26%, transparent 26% 32%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
